publicationDecision.authorisation: Matt's standing Medicines Watch instruction authorises needed evidence-backed informational additions and corrections to go live without repeat permission.
publicationDecision.scope: Publish one newly identified Novo Nordisk Phase 1 programme, correct NNC0662-0419 to its complete current registry stage and add one bounded survodutide specialist-indication study. Editorial authorisation is not clinical approval.

reviewType: AI-assisted primary-source factual review; not clinical approval

entries.name: NNC0721-8060 injection
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted NCT07767175 record describes a first-in-human study of subcutaneous NNC0721-8060 in adults with overweight or obesity. It is recruiting after an actual 12 August 2026 start and includes semaglutide and placebo arms.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed registry evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for NNC0721-8060.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed registry evidence.
entries.supply: A recruiting early-stage trial does not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: The registry does not state a mechanism and has no posted results. Estimated enrolment of 142 and September 2027 completion are not completed evidence. A semaglutide arm does not establish equivalence, superiority or an authorised combination.

fields.stage: Phase 2 obesity and type 2 diabetes studies; no posted results
fields.summaryToAppend: The complete current registry search also finds two active, not-recruiting Phase 2 obesity studies: NCT07184632 is a 224-participant dose-finding study and NCT07639021 is a 233-participant dose-escalation study. A separate recruiting 270-participant Phase 2 study, NCT07415954, evaluates glycaemic control in type 2 diabetes. Two additional Phase 1 records cover single-dose pharmacokinetics across Japanese, Chinese and non-Asian participants and oral-contraceptive pharmacokinetics and gastric emptying.
fields.limitationsToAppend: None of the six identified NNC0662-0419 records has posted results. Active, not-recruiting status does not mean completion or efficacy. The type 2 diabetes study must not be presented as weight-management evidence; supportive pharmacokinetic studies do not establish treatment benefit. Estimated completions, comparator arms and enrolment do not establish superiority, authorisation, access or supply.

fields.stage: Phase 3 obesity, MASH and type 2 diabetes programmes
fields.summaryToAppend: Separately, NCT07754461 records a recruiting 56-week Phase 3 study of survodutide versus placebo for glycaemic control in people with type 2 diabetes, after an actual 24 August 2026 start. Its estimated enrolment is 600.
fields.limitationsToAppend: The type 2 diabetes study has no posted results. Recruitment and an actual start are not completion or evidence of improved glycaemic control, and this specialist-indication study must not be presented as a completed weight-management result or a new authorised indication.

discoveryPass.programmeLevelCheck: A ClinicalTrials.gov API search for NNC0662-0419 returned six records. The existing Watch already linked the first-in-human record; all five additional records were read before correcting the stage. A separate NNC0721-8060 API search returned one record.
discoveryPass.included: NNC0721-8060 was absent. NNC0662-0419 was stale at completed Phase 1 despite current Phase 2 obesity and diabetes studies. The survodutide diabetes Phase 3 record is attached to the existing programme.
discoveryPass.notDuplicated: No open Medicines Watch review PR was present. Existing NNC0662-0419 Phase 1 and survodutide obesity, MASH and publication evidence remain intact.
